hud.note: Translucent; ramp is for the opaque navy base.

display.purpose: Final-result plate and pregame count; 44px on phones.

headline.purpose: Overlay and pregame headings; lineup plate at 46px, network slab at 34px.

title.purpose: Mode names on lower-third bars, calling-card names, rank names (19-23px).

numeral.purpose: Scores, stat values, level numbers (28-42px). Tabular; ticks on change.

body.purpose: Mode rules and explanatory sentences; long explanations cap at 70ch.

caption.purpose: Sub-lines, settings hints and stat captions in dim (12-13px).

label.purpose: Chips, tabs, segments, table heads (15-19px, 0.04-0.08em, uppercase).

label-tracked.purpose: Names that title a real block: rail heads, mode groups, team tags, HUD mode name (13-17px, 0.12-0.16em, uppercase).

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Menu and overlay cards only; the one ambient lift in the system.

shadows.name: hud-legibility
shadows.purpose: Free-floating HUD text over the 3D scene; removed on solid plates.

motion.name: wipe
motion.value: clip-path from a zero-width polygon to var(--shape), 0.3-0.5s ease-out
motion.purpose: Bars, tags, plates and rows slide in along their own slant; wipe-r enters from the right for away-side and right-rail pieces.

motion.name: wipe-stagger-modes
motion.purpose: Lower-third mode bars on tab change.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: A changed number rolls up into place (scores, player counts).

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion and the in-game reduce-motion setting replace every animation with a fade.

components.name: Primary Slab
components.description: The one yellow primary action per screen, cut on its trailing edge.
components.css: .ds-slab { padding: 14px 36px 14px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--yellow, #ffc400); color: var(--ink, #0b1220); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-slab:hover { background: var(--yellow-hi, #ffd23d); } .ds-slab:active { background: #e6b000; } .ds-slab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffc400); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slab:disabled { background: var(--line, #26365a); color: var(--dim, #a9b8cf); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Secondary actions and options: outlined, square; selected turns paper; disabled goes dashed.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 7px 14px 6px; border: 2px solid var(--line-2, #3a4d75); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #f4f6f8); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.12s, background 0.12s; } .ds-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--paper, #f4f6f8); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffc400); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip.ds-on { background: var(--paper, #f4f6f8); border-color: var(--paper, #f4f6f8); color: var(--ink, #0b1220); } .ds-chip:disabled { border-style: dashed; color: var(--mute, #8798b4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 320px; } .ds-field span { color: var(--dim, #a9b8cf); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { padding: 6px 8px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line-2, #3a4d75); border-radius: 0; background: var(--navy, #0b1220); color: var(--fg, #f4f6f8); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; outline: none; caret-color: var(--yellow, #ffc400); } .ds-field input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--yellow, #ffc400); }

components.name: Scorebug Tabs

components.html: FPS Shooter
components.css: .ds-bug { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 64px; background: var(--navy, #0b1220); } .ds-net { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 40px 0 22px; background: var(--yellow, #ffc400); color: var(--ink, #0b1220); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-tabs { display: flex; margin-left: -10px; padding: 0 32px 0 24px; background: var(--panel, #16213a); clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 16px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--dim, #a9b8cf); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 transparent; transition: color 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--fg, #f4f6f8); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffc400); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-tab.ds-on { color: var(--fg, #f4f6f8); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--yellow, #ffc400); }

components.name: Lower-third Mode Bar
components.description: Team-size tag interlocked with a paper bar; the selected bar turns yellow.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: 60px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffc400); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-mtag { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 96px; padding-right: 10px; background: var(--tag, #4a5872); color: #fff; font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-mbar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; flex: 1; margin-left: -12px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 26px; background: var(--paper, #f4f6f8); color: var(--ink, #0b1220); clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-mbar strong { font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mbar span { color: var(--paper-ink, #3b4a60); font-family: Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-mode:hover .ds-mbar { background: #fff; } .ds-mode.ds-on .ds-mbar { background: var(--yellow, #ffc400); } .ds-mode.ds-on .ds-mbar span { color: var(--yellow-ink, #4d3b00); }

components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; width: 380px; padding: 4px; background: var(--panel, #16213a); } .ds-seg button { padding: 10px 0 9px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--dim, #a9b8cf); font-family: "Saira Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--fg, #f4f6f8); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--yellow, #ffc400); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button.ds-on { background: var(--paper, #f4f6f8); color: var(--ink, #0b1220); }

narrative.overview:
Every match is a televised event. The menus and the in-match HUD are one sports-TV graphics set: a scorebug strip across the top of the menu, lower-third bars for the modes, a pregame roster that fills like a studio pre-show, a starting-lineup slam before the match, a scorebug over the game, and a final-score card at the end. The system rejects the dark, rounded-card web dashboard the game used before. Nothing is soft, floating or glowing. Graphics are flat plates of colour with hard edges that slide in.

Density is broadcast density. Big condensed numerals and names, short uppercase labels, and one sentence of plain prose where a rule needs explaining. The ground is deep navy. Information sits on paper-white plates with navy type, the way a lower third reads over any footage. Network yellow is scarce and always means "this is the action" or "this is you". Team red and blue appear only as tags and slabs.

Motion is the signature. Bars, tags and lineup rows wipe in along their own slant, staggered. Numbers that change roll up into place. With reduced motion, every wipe becomes a short fade.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, paper-white plates, one network-yellow action per screen.
Saira Condensed 700/800 uppercase for every label, name and numeral; Saira for prose.
Square corners everywhere; the slanted cut appears only on slabs, tags and bars.
State shown by form as well as colour: solid live, dashed pending, struck through locked.
The wipe and the number tick are the only motion vocabulary.

rules.name: The One Slab Rule
rules.body: Each screen carries exactly one yellow primary-action slab. Secondary actions are outlined chips, never a second yellow button.

rules.name: The Yellow Means You Rule
rules.body: Outside the primary action and the active marks, yellow only ever marks the player: your row, your XP, your code. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Team Token Rule
rules.body: Team colour comes from red, blue, red-slab and blue-slab only, so the colourblind overrides reach every surface.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything a broadcaster would put on screen (labels, names, numbers, buttons) is Saira Condensed uppercase. Sentences are Saira in sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the root) so ticking scores never jitter.

rules.name: The Plates Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: UI chrome separates by plate colour, not by shadow. The only lift is the overlay card.

rules.name: The Cut Belongs to Slabs Rule
rules.body: The slant is only for slabs, tags and bars. Cards, tiles, inputs and chips stay plain rectangles.

dos: Do set the outline of every slanted piece as `--shape` so the wipe opens along that same cut.
Do wipe new bars, tags and rows in with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` over 0.3-0.5s, staggered, and tick changed numbers up over 0.3-0.35s.
Do show state by form as well as colour: solid for live, dashed for pending, struck through and greyed for locked.
Do draw UI icons from the shared set: a 24-unit grid, 2.2px square-capped mitred strokes, coloured by `currentColor`.
Do read team colour from the team tokens so colourblind modes and the high-contrast HUD (solid black behind readouts) keep working.
Do let cosmetic previews and calling cards keep their item's own colours; they are player content, not chrome.
donts: Don't round UI corners, use pills, or put gradients or glows on menu or HUD chrome. Full-screen effects (damage vignette, scope, zone tint, heal flash) and cosmetic previews keep their gradients and glows.
Don't put a second yellow button on a screen, or use yellow as decoration.
Don't apply the slanted cut to cards, tiles, inputs or chips.
Don't set a label, name or number in Saira body, or set prose in condensed uppercase.
Don't add a tracked label above a heading that only repeats it.
Don't use typed glyphs or emoji as UI icons.
